messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

I don’t need the trailer myself, so I have no dates or duration to give, and I’m not sure whether anyone’s dates can move. It would be good to settle pickup, where it will be stored, and access to my pad. I rent, and my landlord would need to approve any change to what’s kept there—I haven’t asked him yet. I did agree to the arrangement, so I’d want a plan all three of us accept.

I need it in the next few weeks for my own home project. I can’t give exact dates or how long yet, and the timing can move somewhat—but I’m not agreeing to wait until A is done. We need to settle pickup, return, storage, and access at B’s pad; I don’t know whether access is a problem. Working with A may help us coordinate, but it doesn’t change when I need it. A fair plan needs clear use dates and a workable turn for each of us, accepted by all three.

I don’t have exact dates yet. I need it for weekend trips in the next few weeks; the dates can move somewhat, but I need us to settle a plan within that time. We should agree on pickup, return, and access at B’s pad. A fair plan needs to schedule everyone’s use and make those arrangements clear.

Change needed: I’m not quite comfortable with the trailer staying on my pad indefinitely. Could we add a date to agree on storage after the first turns? I’d need to check with my landlord before anything changes here.

I don’t have exact dates or trip lengths yet; I need it for weekend trips in the next few weeks. Dates can move somewhat, but I need a turn soon. Pickup, return, and access at B’s pad need to be clear. Working with C may help us coordinate, but it doesn’t change my timing. A fair plan needs clear turns and enough flexibility for each of us to use the trailer.
Accept. I’ll coordinate exact dates and duration with C before pickup.
I still accept. I’ll coordinate exact dates and duration with A before pickup.
Thanks for the update. I’ll confirm the pickup and return windows, and ask my landlord before any storage change.
Got it. I’ll coordinate exact dates and duration with A before pickup.
